title: feat: Automation API — HTTP Route CRUD + Client SDK + Execution History
body:
Completes the Automation Service → HTTP API → Client SDK pipeline, unblocking ObjectUI P1.6 Automation Builder.

### API Protocol Schema (`api/automation-api.zod.ts`)
- 9 endpoint contracts: `listFlows`, `getFlow`, `createFlow`, `updateFlow`, `deleteFlow`, `triggerFlow`, `toggleFlow`, `listRuns`, `getRun`
- `AutomationApiContracts` registry, `AutomationApiErrorCode` enum, path param schemas
- 32 tests

### IAutomationService Contract Extension
- Added optional methods: `getFlow`, `toggleFlow`, `listRuns`, `getRun`

### AutomationEngine Execution History
- `flowEnabled` map for toggle support — disabled flows reject execution
- In-memory `executionLogs` with log rotation (max 1000 entries)
- Each `execute()` records run ID, timing, trigger context, status
- 15 new tests (42 total)

### HTTP Dispatcher (9 routes)
```
GET    /automation              → listFlows
GET    /automation/:name        → getFlow
POST   /automation              → createFlow
PUT    /automation/:name        → updateFlow
DELETE /automation/:name        → deleteFlow
POST   /automation/:name/trigger → execute
POST   /automation/:name/toggle  → toggleFlow
GET    /automation/:name/runs   → listRuns (query params)
GET    /automation/:name/runs/:runId → getRun
```
Legacy `POST /automation/trigger/:name` preserved for backward compatibility.

### Client SDK (`client.automation.*`)
```typescript
client.automation.list()
client.automation.get('approval_flow')
client.automation.create('new_flow', definition)
client.automation.update('approval_flow', definition)
client.automation.delete('old_flow')
client.automation.toggle('approval_flow', false)
client.automation.runs.list('approval_flow', { limit: 10 })
client.automation.runs.get('approval_flow', 'run_123')
```

### ROADMAP
- Updated automation section with API/SDK/history entries
- Test count: 5,953 spec + 42 service-automation + 29 runtime
